title: Daemon connect failure: opaque errno 2; no fallback or KANBUS_NO_DAEMON hint
description:
Inside a filesystem-restricted Codex sandbox:
  kbs list / kbs now / kbs daemon-status

All returned only:
  No such file or directory (os error 2)

Meanwhile create/show/ready worked; KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1 kbs list worked.

Likely cause: daemon socket outside sandbox writable paths.

Expected: If daemon spawn/connect fails, read commands should fall back to direct file access, or report the socket path and suggest KANBUS_NO_DAEMON=1.

Note: project policy prefers one path over silent dual fallback; prefer clear diagnostics + documented env escape hatch unless SD chooses intentional FS fallback.
right_now_summary: Read commands still fail with opaque errno 2 when the daemon socket is inaccessible.
